goal: Bind trusted SelectedExecutors to generated dependencies, real source APIs, and runtime evidence, then attempt one official real-project acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Each SelectedExecutor becomes one bounded integration contract with exact dependency, required API symbols, and delegation rules.
Only responsible generation context receives the selected executor projection and Provider cannot silently substitute a library.
Dependency and AST source validation are deterministic and ignore README, comments, and dead documentation.
Integration receipts bind the selected executor and current generated source identity; stale receipts fail closed.
Runtime evidence identifies the installed exact version and actual external API path.
Candidate replacement remains bounded and exhaustion yields Agent Build without stale external contracts.
No new Agent, scheduler, executor type, lifecycle stage, formal authority, packager, or delivery route is introduced.
